description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable LogEntry class with methods for creating instances from JSON, converting to JSON, and accessing log entry data. It uses builder pattern for object creation and contains detailed parsing and validation logic for JSON input.

classes.name: ImmutableLogEntry
classes.description: Immutable implementation of LogEntry, representing a log record with various fields including timestamp, category, type, level, message, optional address and thing ID. Provides JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Inner class implementing builder pattern for creating ImmutableLogEntry instances, allowing optional setting of address and thing ID, with validation on required fields.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableLogEntry instance from a JsonObject, parsing and validating required fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the log entry into a JsonObject, with optional fields included if set.
